text: Importantly, the time course of evaluation in the current literature was generally limited to several hours post-exercise and thus does not provide a complete snapshot of the adaptive response, which can last in excess of 24 hours. Furthermore, these findings are specific to acute bouts of exercise, whereas any interference would seemingly manifest over a period of weeks or months.
